Complete Dental Care · GK-II, New Delhi

Every Treatment.
Every Specialist.

No procedure at VinSmiles is performed by a generalist. From a routine filling to a full mouth reconstruction, every treatment below is delivered by a specialist who trained specifically for it, using technology found in the best clinics anywhere in the world.

01 Preventive

Conservative Dentistry

The guiding principle here is simple: save as much of your natural tooth as possible. Modern materials and techniques let us repair decay and damage while removing the absolute minimum of healthy structure. What nature gave you is always better than what we can replace it with.

What this includes
  • Tooth Coloured Restorations and Fillings
  • Fluoride Application
  • Pit and Fissure Sealants
  • Minimal Intervention Dentistry
Book Now
02 Restorative

Dental Implants

A dental implant replaces the root of a missing tooth with a titanium post, then restores it with a crown that looks and functions exactly like a natural tooth. Every implant at VinSmiles is planned using CBCT 3D imaging before a single incision is made, so placement is precise and predictable.

What this includes
  • Conventional Implants
  • Immediate Implants
  • Missing Tooth Replacement
  • Mini Dental Implants
  • All on Six / All on Eight
  • Sinus Lift and Bone Graft
  • Implant Supported Overdentures
Book Now
03 Cosmetic

Dental Veneers

Ultra-thin porcelain shells bonded to the front of your teeth, transforming colour, shape, size and alignment in two visits. Where preparation is required it is minimal, and in many cases no drilling is needed at all. The result is permanent and, done well, entirely undetectable.

What this includes
  • Porcelain Veneers
  • Ultra-Thin Lumineers
  • Composite Veneers
  • No-Prep Veneers
  • Emax Laminates
  • Full Smile Veneer Sets
Book Now
04 Specialist

Endodontics

Root canal treatment has a reputation it no longer deserves. With computer-controlled anaesthesia and rotary instrumentation, most straightforward cases are completed comfortably in a single sitting. The goal is always the same: save the natural tooth rather than remove it.

What this includes
  • Root Canal Treatment
  • Single Sitting RCT
  • Post and Core Build Ups
  • Dental Crowns (PFM, MLS, Metal Free)
  • Re-treatment of Failed RCT
Book Now
05 Complex

Full Mouth Rehabilitation

When wear, decay or tooth loss has affected the entire mouth, individual fixes are not enough. Full mouth rehabilitation is a coordinated plan that rebuilds bite, function, health and appearance together, drawing on every specialist under our roof to work as one team.

What this includes
  • Complete Bite Reconstruction
  • Multi-Specialist Coordinated Planning
  • Implant Supported Full Arch
  • Crown and Bridge Rehabilitation
  • Bite Raising and TMJ Correction
  • Aesthetic Smile Integration
Book Now
06 Paediatric

Kids Dentistry

A child who is comfortable at the dentist becomes an adult who is comfortable at the dentist. Our paediatric care focuses on making early visits calm and positive, while addressing decay, spacing and habits before they become larger problems later on.

What this includes
  • Pulpectomy and Pulpotomy
  • Stainless Steel Crowns
  • Strip Crowns
  • Space Maintainers
  • Habit Breaking Appliances
  • In Office Fluoride Application
  • Myofunctional Appliances
Book Now
07 Advanced

Laser Dentistry

Diode laser technology replaces the scalpel in a growing range of soft-tissue procedures. Cutting with focused light means minimal bleeding, rarely any stitches, and healing measured in a day or two rather than a week. It is also considerably more precise than any blade.

What this includes
  • Laser Gum Contouring
  • Gum De-Pigmentation
  • Laser Assisted Whitening
  • Soft Tissue Surgery
  • Frenectomy
  • Crown Lengthening
Book Now
08 Surgical

Oral and Maxillofacial Surgery

From impacted wisdom teeth to jaw cysts and surgical extractions, oral surgery covers the procedures that require a surgeon rather than a general dentist. Every case is assessed with 3D imaging first, and performed under anaesthesia that keeps you genuinely comfortable throughout.

What this includes
  • Wisdom Tooth Removal (Dis-Impaction)
  • Surgical Extraction
  • Jaw Cysts
  • Root End Surgery
  • Bone Grafting
  • All Minor Surgical Procedures
Book Now
09 Alignment

Orthodontics

Straightening teeth is about far more than appearance. Correct alignment improves how you bite, how you clean, and how long your teeth last. VinSmiles is a certified Invisalign provider, offering clear aligners alongside conventional fixed braces depending on what your case actually needs.

What this includes
  • Invisalign Treatment
  • Clear Aligners
  • Fixed Braces (Metal and Ceramic)
  • Occlusal Stents
  • Habit Breaking Appliances
  • Pre-Treatment Trainers
  • Retainers
Book Now
10 Specialist

Periodontics

Your gums and the bone beneath them are the foundation every tooth stands on. Periodontal care at VinSmiles ranges from routine ultrasonic cleaning to laser-assisted surgery and gum contouring. Healthy gums are not a cosmetic detail. They are what makes everything else last.

What this includes
  • Ultrasonic Cleaning
  • De-Pigmentation
  • Flap Surgery
  • Curettage and Root Planning
  • Gingivectomy
  • Crown Lengthening
  • Gum Correction
  • Laser Gum Surgery
Book Now
11 Restorative

Prosthodontics

Prosthodontics is the specialty that restores what is missing or damaged, rebuilding function, comfort and appearance together. Dr. Neha Sachdeva is a specialist prosthodontist, which means the most complex restorative work at VinSmiles is handled by someone who trained specifically for it.

What this includes
  • Fixed Partial Dentures
  • Porcelain and Ceramic Crowns
  • Metal Free Crowns
  • Removable Partial Dentures
  • Complete Dentures
  • BPS Dentures
  • Overdentures
Book Now
12 Cosmetic

Smile Designing

Smile designing begins with your face, not your teeth. Using digital smile design, we map proportions, symmetry and character before any treatment starts, and you approve the simulated result before we begin. No guesswork. No surprises at the end.

What this includes
  • Digital Smile Design
  • Dental Laminates and Veneers
  • Lumineers
  • Emax Crowns
  • Composite Bonding
  • Tooth Jewellery
Book Now
13 Cosmetic

Teeth Whitening

Professional whitening lifts stains that no toothpaste can reach, typically brightening several shades in a single session. Supervised in-clinic treatment produces results that last significantly longer than home kits, without the sensitivity that comes from unregulated products.

What this includes
  • In-Office Professional Whitening
  • Laser Assisted Whitening
  • Take Home Whitening Kits
  • Internal Bleaching for Single Teeth
  • Stain Removal and Polishing
Book Now
